contract.purpose: Define attachment metadata shape that round-trips between dashboard protocol, server context, session messages, and model payload assembly.
contract.scope: Attachment kinds, preview/excerpt metadata, workspace relativity, and user-message attachment fields.

invariants.invariant-1: Attachment metadata remains structured on user messages until final provider payload mapping stage.
invariants.invariant-2: Local-only attachment fields are not emitted as raw `attachments` in provider API payloads.
